name: BrightEdge IX Foundation (be_ixf_drupal)
description: Integrates BrightEdge's Instant eXperience Framework (IXF): the bundled PHP SDK fetches vendor-managed "capsules" over cURL at render time and injects the returned SEO markup, meta tags, and redirects into node pages server-side.
project_description: BrightEdge IX Foundation module. Connects a Drupal site to the BrightEdge (bc0a.com) enterprise SEO platform via the bundled brightedge/be_ixf_php_sdk. At render time the SDK issues a cURL request to the BrightEdge capsule API (https://ixfd-api.bc0a.com by default), keyed by the account ID and a hash of the current page URL, and returns a "capsule" of JSON. The module injects the capsule's head content into html_head via hook_page_attachments(), exposes an IXFContentBlock block plugin that emits body-level capsule content, and runs a kernel RESPONSE event subscriber (RedirectHTTPHeaders) that applies any capsule-defined redirect. Configure the account ID, capsule mode, optional API endpoint, canonical host/protocol, and block cache lifetime at /admin/config/services/brightedge. Requires a valid BrightEdge account. Current release 8.x-5.10.
